quote: Sandvik has received a major order for underground mining equipment from the Canadian mining company Aris Mining, to be used at the Marmato gold mine in Colombia. The order is valued at around SEK 250 million and was booked in the first quarter of 2026. The order consists of underground trucks, loaders and drill rigs, with deliveries expected to begin in the second quarter of 2026 and continue through the second quarter of 2027.
